articles.summary: While you won't find empty roads and abandoned national parks when summer is officially over, the end of the season does mark a shift in RV travel. Of course, the most popular destinations will usually still need advanced reservations; however, you'll find that other great RVing locations across the country are much less busy and easier to book once peak season ends.
articles.title: Embracing Off-Season RV Travel with Winnebago

articles.summary: Winnebago is teaming up with McDonald’s as a prize partner to bring back the iconic MONOPOLY® Game at McDonald’s after nearly a decade.
articles.title: Two iconic brands, one iconic game - Winnebago and McDonald's team up for the return of the MONOPOLY® Game
